title: V4 Hook Fee Conformance
description: Recomputes a Uniswap v4 pool’s per-swap fee from v4-core’s own rules at pinned a7cf038cd568801a79a9b4cf92cd5b52c95c8585 (calculateSwapFee composition), validates the packed protocol fee and LP-fee bounds, decodes the 0x400000 override, and checks each emitted fee: CONFORMS, OUT_OF_BOUNDS, FEE_MISMATCH, or INDETERMINATE. Accrues the declared hook charge in integer arithmetic with remainders reported; LP revenue reported separately, never netted. Evidence only; zero network.

protocol_fee.description: uint24, both directions packed as v4 stores it: low 12 bits zeroForOne, bits 12-23 oneForZero; validated with isValidProtocolFee (each direction <= 1000 pips).

pool_fee.description: uint24: static LP fee in pips, or 0x800000 (8388608) for a dynamic-fee pool.

declared_lp_fee_bounds.description: { min_pips, max_pips }: the LP-fee band the declared story permits (0..1000000).

declared_total_fee_cap_pips.description: Optional total cap in pips; the composed swap fee plus the hook-charge rate is checked against it.

declared_hook_charge.description: { rate_pips, splits: [{ recipient_label, share_bps }] }: the separately declared hook charge; shares are reported as declared, never coerced.

swaps.description: Each swap: { index, zero_for_one, amount_in, emitted_fee_pips, lp_fee_override? (raw uint24 incl. the 0x400000 flag), exact_out? }.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads: protocol_fee, pool_fee, declared_lp_fee_bounds, declared_total_fee_cap_pips (optional), declared_hook_charge, swaps.

assumptions: Fee rules pinned to Uniswap v4-core at commit a7cf038cd568801a79a9b4cf92cd5b52c95c8585: LPFeeLibrary.sol (flags, MAX_LP_FEE), ProtocolFeeLibrary.sol (isValidProtocolFee, calculateSwapFee), Pool.sol L301-320 (fee composition and the emitted Swap fee), SwapMath.sol MAX_SWAP_FEE.
calculateSwapFee replica: swapFee = protocolFee + lpFee - floor(protocolFee * lpFee / 1000000), in pips, per direction; a zero protocol fee means the whole fee is the LP fee.
All monetary accruals are integer floor divisions in BigInt; every division remainder is reported and never silently dropped.
LP revenue (amount_in * lpFee / 1e6) is reported separately and is never netted against the hook charge: LP revenue stays LP revenue.
Exact-out swaps and composed fees at or above MAX_SWAP_FEE are reported INDETERMINATE: v4 reverts at that boundary and this node does not model reverts.
A dynamic pool fee (0x800000) without a per-swap override leaves the LP fee unknowable to an off-chain observer and is reported INDETERMINATE.
Zero network: the node never reads a chain and recomputes only the caller-supplied declared values and emitted fees.
